cohort: 342 female patients with systemic sclerosis (SSc) from the Chinese Organization for Scleroderma
finding: Female patients with SSc experience impaired reproductive health, including earlier menopause, higher rates of spontaneous abortions, premature births, low birth weight infants, and cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was significantly higher in patients with systemic sclerosis compared to healthy controls.
